## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing tests in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_ledger.py` covering local-mode cycle ledger init.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2 (partial): local cycle ledger at $ARTIFACTS_DIR/cycle-ledger.json with per-branch + SHA-aware semantics.

## Specific failing test method names

1. `test_local_workflow_reads_existing_ledger` — write cycle-ledger.json with 1 cycle entry; assert helper returns ledger + cycle_num=2.
2. `test_local_workflow_starts_fresh_when_no_ledger` — no ledger file, no PR_NUMBER; assert empty ledger + cycle_num=1.
3. `test_local_workflow_resets_on_sha_change` — ledger has last commit_sha != HEAD; assert cycle_num=1 returned (reset semantics).
4. `test_local_workflow_continues_on_same_sha` — ledger has last commit_sha == HEAD; assert cycle_num = last_cycle_num + 1.
5. `test_local_workflow_no_pr_reconstruction_path` — assert `reconstruct_from_pr_comments` is NEVER called in local mode (pr_number=None always).

## Behavioral assertions

Mock `cycle_ledger.read_ledger` and `cycle_ledger.reconstruct_from_pr_comments`. Assert OBSERVABLE outcomes (return values, mock-call presence/absence).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 5 test methods defined with the names above
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_ledger.py -q --co | grep -c 'test_local_workflow_'   # expect 5
- [ ] All 5 tests fail on current main (local_workflow module does not exist)
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_ledger.py -q 2>&1 | grep -E '(FAILED|ERROR|ModuleNotFoundError)' | wc -l   # expect ≥ 5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_ledger.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_ledger.py

## File Impact
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_ledger.py (new, ~180 lines)
